title: centella asiatica var. floridana
intro: Centella asiatica var. floridana, commonly known as Gotu Kola, is a variety of the Asiatic pennywort plant native to the southeastern United States. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including improving cognitive function, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Centella asiatica var. floridana are attributed to its ability to enhance blood flow, reduce inflammation, and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
